procedures.name: Core Operations: Change and Problem Management - Problem Management

steps.quote: Trigger: A Problem must be created (create_problem) when a recurring incident pattern or a major incident is identified.
Linking: The Problem record must link all affected Incidents via the incident_to_problem related list.
Default Status: All new Problems are set to status = new.

Workaround: If workaround/temporary solution found, update workaround field and set status=fix_in_progress. The workaround_notes must be published to the linked Incidents and relevant Knowledge Articles.
Final Status: A Problem transitions to closed only after the permanent fix has been successfully implemented via a linked normal or emergency Change Request.
Priority Calculation: Priority (critical, high, moderate, low, planning) is determined automatically by the system based on a below pre-defined matrix of Impact x Urgency.

procedures.name: Knowledge Management

steps.quote: Article Status: Only articles in knowledge.state = published are searchable by the Reporter role.
Search Policy: When an Incident is created, a search for relevant knowledge must be performed, and matching articles should be linked.

Knowledge Creation Policy: If an Incident is marked resolved and no existing knowledge article was linked, and the resolution is not a simple password reset, the Agent must be prompted to create and link a new knowledge draft before final closure.
Use Tracking: All knowledge links must track kb_use type: suggested (suggested for resolution), applied (applied during resolution), or resolution (used as resolution).

procedures.name: Core Operations: Change and Problem Management - Problem Management

steps.quote: Trigger: A Problem must be created (create_problem) when a recurring incident pattern or a major incident is identified.
Linking: The Problem record must link all affected Incidents via the incident_to_problem related list.
Default Status: All new Problems are set to status = new.

Workaround: If workaround/temporary solution found, update workaround field and set status=fix_in_progress. The workaround_notes must be published to the linked Incidents and relevant Knowledge Articles.
Final Status: A Problem transitions to closed only after the permanent fix has been successfully implemented via a linked normal or emergency Change Request.
Priority Calculation: Priority (critical, high, moderate, low, planning) is determined automatically by the system based on a below pre-defined matrix of Impact x Urgency.

procedures.name: Knowledge Management

steps.quote: Article Status: Only articles in knowledge.state = published are searchable by the Reporter role.
Search Policy: When an Incident is created, a search for relevant knowledge must be performed, and matching articles should be linked.

Knowledge Creation Policy: If an Incident is marked resolved and no existing knowledge article was linked, and the resolution is not a simple password reset, the Agent must be prompted to create and link a new knowledge draft before final closure.
Use Tracking: All knowledge links must track kb_use type: suggested (suggested for resolution), applied (applied during resolution), or resolution (used as resolution).

statements.text: Trigger: A Problem must be created (create_problem) when a recurring incident pattern or a major incident is identified.

statements.text: Linking: The Problem record must link all affected Incidents via the incident_to_problem related list.

statements.text: CI Status: Only CIs with status = in_use or status = maintenance can be linked to active Incidents. Do not link CIs in status = retired or status = disposed.

statements.text: CI Owner: All CIs must have a recorded owner_id.
statements.quote: CI Owner: All CIs must have a recorded owner_id.

statements.text: SLA Application: SLAs are automatically aligned based on priority linked to the incident.

statements.text: Metric: Metrics tracked are limited to target_mins.
statements.quote: Metric: Metrics tracked are limited to target_mins.

statements.text: SLA Pause: The SLA timer must be paused (stage = paused) when the Incident is in state = on_hold and the on_hold_reason is one of the following enumerations: Awaiting Change, Awaiting Caller, or Awaiting Problem.
statements.quote: SLA Pause: The SLA timer must be paused (stage = paused) when the Incident is in state = on_hold and the on_hold_reason is one of the following enumerations: Awaiting Change, Awaiting Caller, or Awaiting Problem.

statements.text: Breach: If the SLA exceeds its duration (stage = breached), the escalation flag on the Incident must be set to true, and an automatic notification sent to the Manager.
statements.quote: Breach: If the SLA exceeds its duration (stage = breached), the escalation flag on the Incident must be set to true, and an automatic notification sent to the Manager.

statements.text: Article Status: Only articles in knowledge.state = published are searchable by the Reporter role.
statements.quote: Article Status: Only articles in knowledge.state = published are searchable by the Reporter role.

statements.text: Search Policy: When an Incident is created, a search for relevant knowledge must be performed, and matching articles should be linked.
statements.quote: Search Policy: When an Incident is created, a search for relevant knowledge must be performed, and matching articles should be linked.

statements.text: Knowledge Creation Policy: If an Incident is marked resolved and no existing knowledge article was linked, and the resolution is not a simple password reset, the Agent must be prompted to create and link a new knowledge draft before final closure.
statements.quote: Knowledge Creation Policy: If an Incident is marked resolved and no existing knowledge article was linked, and the resolution is not a simple password reset, the Agent must be prompted to create and link a new knowledge draft before final closure.

statements.text: Use Tracking: All knowledge links must track kb_use type: suggested (suggested for resolution), applied (applied during resolution), or resolution (used as resolution).
statements.quote: Use Tracking: All knowledge links must track kb_use type: suggested (suggested for resolution), applied (applied during resolution), or resolution (used as resolution).

statements.text: Used as for knowledge base to incident: When the knowledge is found through automated search it should be linked as suggested.
statements.quote: Used as for knowledge base to incident: When the knowledge is found through automated search it should be linked as suggested.

statements.text: If the knowledge is found to be useful to resolve the incident or is being created after incident resolution it should have used as type to resolution in linking.
statements.quote: If the knowledge is found to be useful to resolve the incident or is being created after incident resolution it should have used as type to resolution in linking.

statements.text: In other incidents if knowledge is linked it should be as applied.
statements.quote: In other incidents if knowledge is linked it should be as applied.
